WIPO Lex includes national legal materials; item-level ownership and service-specific terms are not established here. Keep collection and commercial reuse unknown until rights for each record are confirmed.

sources.permission_evidence: Rights and permissions page reviewed 2026-10-24. ILO states that its own publications and datasets/metadata published on or after 2023-05-03 are generally CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise indicated; older publications do not automatically receive that licence, and third-party components require separate clearance. NATLEX-linked national legislation is not presumed to be ILO-owned content. Keep collection and commercial reuse unknown for legal-text copies until item-specific rights and service terms are confirmed.
